hook: An enemy center looks weak. Is it an opening—or an invitation?
short_setup: You hold the heights, but the chance to strike may vanish.
why_option_a_made_sense: Advancing promised initiative against a seemingly exposed enemy.
why_option_b_made_sense: Holding preserved the strongest verified advantage: terrain.
actual_decision_explanation: The Allied plan committed forces away from the heights.
outcome_story: French forces seized the heights and divided the Allied army.
hindsight_analysis: The bad outcome does not make every aggressive choice irrational. The key failure was treating an enemy signal as reliable without protecting against deception.
decision_principle: When information may be adversarial, preserve options until the signal is verified.
